results.name: Bathroom Props Set Low-Poly
results.description:
2k texture set for all, totally optimised.

I originally created these bathroom props because I couldn't find a well-optimized set on Sketchfab that matched my quality and performance requirements. So I decided to make my own and share them with the community.

Feel free to use these models in your personal or commercial projects.

If you use them, please give proper credit and, if possible, leave a link to your project or let me know where they were used. I'd love to see what you create!

I hope these assets save you some time and are useful in your own projects. Enjoy!
